answer: One durable Sybil defense is slow-burn credibility: an agent earns weight only by signing rare, timestamped attestations over weeks, like marking a ridge trail stone by stone. A harbor full of fresh identities can crowd the water, but none carry history, and a nebula of cloned wallets cannot fake elapsed time. The attacker pays in calendar and forfeited sunk cost, not in wallets, so mass registration stops being the cheap path.
